선택한 모니터의 화면 내용이 대기 시간 동안 바뀌지 않으면 그 화면만 검: A selected monitor is covered in black when its content does not change for the set wait time. Moving the pointer onto that monitor or changing its content removes the cover. A monitor with the pointer on it stays visible; other monitors continue to be monitored.
배경화면 움직임 무시를 켜면 Lively 같은 움직이는 배경화면과 앱 주: Ignore wallpaper motion excludes animated wallpapers, such as Lively, and desktop areas around app windows from comparison. Changes inside app windows are still detected.
Ctrl + Alt + F9 / F10으로 지정한 모니터를 강제로 가립니: Ctrl + Alt + F9 / F10 covers the assigned monitor. Move the pointer onto that monitor to remove the cover. If the pointer is already there, move it out and back in. Pressing the same shortcut again also removes the cover.
설정 창을 열면 감시를 일시정지합니다. ‘감시 시작’을 누르면 설정을 저: Opening settings pauses monitoring. Start monitoring saves your settings and continues in the system tray. When a monitor reconnects, monitoring resumes for saved targets.
DDC/CI 표준 밝기 명령(0x10)으로 모니터를 조절합니다. 모니터: Brightness uses the DDC/CI brightness command (0x10). Enable DDC/CI in your monitor's settings. HDR and some display modes can prevent brightness adjustment.
‘함께 조절’은 선택한 모니터에 동일한 값을 적용합니다. 밝기가 40%,: Linked brightness applies one value to the selected monitors. For example, +5 changes 40% and 60% to 65% on both monitors. With brightness sync on, individual sliders and shortcuts also apply the same value to linked monitors. The group control always adjusts the selected monitors together.
슬라이더에 마우스를 올리면 은은하게 밝아집니다. 실제 밝기는 드래그, 방: Sliders glow on hover. Drag a slider, use arrow keys, scroll, or press +/− to change brightness. One mouse-wheel step changes brightness by 2%.
밝기 단축키는 기본 오른쪽 Alt + F2 / F3입니다. 한국어 키보드: The default brightness shortcuts are Right Alt + F2 / F3. If Right Alt acts as the Korean/English input key, change the modifier in Shortcuts. Ctrl+Alt and AltGr with F9–F12 are reserved for global shortcuts.
Nit values are peak and full-frame luminance metadata reported by Windows. They are not measurements of current brightness. Brightness percentages are not converted to nits.
Win + 방향키를 반복해서 누르면 해당 방향 기준으로 ½ → ⅔ → 전: By default, Win + an arrow key cycles placement from that edge: ½ → ⅔ → the full work area. Win + Del cycles between a centered 16:9 window at the configured width and the full work area. The taskbar is excluded.
Win + Backspace는 현재 모니터 작업 영역의 가로·세로를 각각: By default, Win + Backspace cycles through 50%, 70%, and 100% of the monitor's work-area width and height. The first two sizes are centered; 100% maximizes the window. Both portrait and landscape monitors keep their work-area aspect ratio. Using another placement shortcut or moving or resizing the window resets the cycle.
Windows의 기본 Win + 방향키 동작을 대신합니다. 창 배치 기능: The default bindings replace Windows' Win + arrow behavior. Disable window layout to restore Windows' behavior. Elevated apps and windows with minimum-size limits may not accept the requested placement.
Ctrl + Alt + F12 · 화면 보호 일시정지 / 재시작: Ctrl + Alt + F12 · Pause / resume OLED protection
트레이 아이콘을 두 번 클릭해도 설정을 열 수 있습니다. X 버튼은 트레: Double-click the tray icon to open settings. The X button hides the app in the tray. Use Quit at the bottom left to exit. Start at sign-in launches without a window and starts monitoring with saved settings.
설정은 EXE 옆의 MonitorShade.settings.xml에 보관: Settings are stored in MonitorShade.settings.xml beside the EXE. Screen comparisons stay in memory; images are not saved or sent. Monitoring waits during lock, screen saver, or sleep. A manual pause is not resumed automatically.
화면 공유에는 검은 오버레이 대신 뒤쪽 내용이 보일 수 있습니다. DRM: Screen sharing may show the content behind the black overlay. Change detection may not work with DRM video, exclusive full-screen apps, or secure desktops.
아침 9시의 흰색·살구빛, 낮의 옅은 세이지, 저녁의 올리브색으로 색상이: Colors change with the time of day: white and peach at 09:00, pale sage during the day, and olive in the evening. Choose a fixed palette in General.
설정 화면은 Chromium 기반 WebView2가 그립니다. 한글은 내: The settings UI uses Chromium-based WebView2 with embedded Pretendard and Manrope fonts. Windows DWM Acrylic blurs the area behind the window in real time, without a background-capture helper window.
Windows 11 22H2 이상에서 시스템 투명도 효과가 켜져 있어야: Acrylic requires Windows 11 22H2 or later with system transparency enabled. Unsupported systems and high-contrast mode use a solid background. WebView2 Runtime is required and is managed with Microsoft Edge.
